INSERT INTO mcp_client_agent_bindings
            (org_id, user_identity_id, client_id, agent_identity_id)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
         ON CONFLICT (user_identity_id, client_id)
            DO UPDATE SET agent_identity_id = EXCLUDED.agent_identity_id,
                          updated_at = now()
         RETURNING id
